sentences.Hei. Jeg vil gjerne bestille en time hos: Hello. I'd like to book an appointment with the doctor.
sentences.Jeg føler meg dårlig. Jeg er trøtt og kv: I feel unwell. I'm tired and I feel sick, and I can't concentrate.
sentences.Legen er dessverre veldig opptatt, men d: Unfortunately the doctor is very busy, but you can have an appointment at half past eleven on Friday the 13th.
sentences.Nå, føler du deg fremdeles dårlig?: Well, do you still feel unwell?
sentences.Ja, jeg trenger medisin. Jeg blir ikke f: Yes, I need medicine. I'm not getting better.
sentences.Du trenger ikke medisin, men du er i dår: You don't need medicine, but you're out of shape. Do you exercise?
sentences.Før jogget jeg litt, men nå føler jeg me: I used to jog a bit, but now I feel so sluggish.
sentences.Jeg har tenkt å begynne på treningsstudi: I'm planning to join a gym.
sentences.En god idé. Hvordan er det med kostholde: A good idea. What about your diet?
sentences.Sunt? Tja, jeg vet ikke. Jeg er glad i a: Healthily? Well, I don't know. I love anything sweet, but I do eat salad too.
sentences.Kutt ut cola, sjokolade og kaker. Du vil: Cut out cola, chocolate and cakes. You'll notice a big difference.
sentences.Skal jeg leve på salat?: Am I supposed to live on salad?
sentences.Nei da, men spis mer grønnsaker, frukt,: Not at all, but eat more vegetables, fruit, wholemeal bread, fish and eggs. And start exercising.
sentences.Så kjedelig! Det er akkurat som å høre m: How boring! It's just like listening to my mother.
She's as fit as a fiddle.
I think you should listen to your mother.
sentences.Jeg mener: Hva gjør han?: I mean: what does he do?
sentences.Men hva gjør han når han er frisk?: But what does he do when he's well?
sentences.Å! Men forstår du ikke!? Jeg vil bare vi: Oh! Don't you understand!? I just want to know what your father is when he isn't ill.
